title: GIF fetch script + committed quota ledger (SPEC §6.10)
description: node scripts/fetch-gifs.mjs <exerciseId...>: reads WORKOUTX_KEY from env (never committed), downloads missing GIFs to data/gifs/ paced under 30 req/min, appends to a quota ledger file (calls used, date). ~330 of 500 monthly calls remain; every new block spends from this budget, so batch GIF fetches per design session.
acceptance_criteria: running it twice for the same ids costs zero API calls; ledger reflects reality

title: Warm-up & cooldown blocks (designed with owner)
description: 2-3 reusable ~5-min blocks picked from the catalog with the user: a general dynamic warm-up, a dumbbell-session warm-up, a stretch cooldown. Fetch their GIFs. These become the prefix/suffix for 40+ min composed sessions.
acceptance_criteria: blocks validate against schema; every interval has a GIF; user has signed off on the exercise selection

title: Two 20-30 min dumbbell strength routines (designed with owner)
description: Two sessions built from the catalog with the user (e.g. full-body A/B), structured as blocks so pieces can be reused. Sensible interval format for strength (longer work, longer rest than HIIT).
acceptance_criteria: both routines validate, have GIFs, and appear in the picker; user approved the plan

title: Physio: owner interview, reputable-source research, rehab/mobility blocks with citations. HARD RULE: not before MVP phone test
description: User explicitly wants this AFTER the MadFit MVP is running on their phone. Run a focused interview on problem areas, then research reputable physio sources (not fitness-blog sludge) and build 1-2 rehab/mobility blocks per area, with citations in the block file's notes. Do not start before ft-c1b.10 is closed.
acceptance_criteria: interview done; each block cites its sources; user signed off

title: Compose 40+ min sessions from blocks (pure data)
description: Once blocks exist: warm-up + MadFit + cooldown, and warm-up + strength + core + cooldown as named routines in the picker. Pure data work; zero new app code if the schema held up.
acceptance_criteria: at least one 40+ min composed session in the picker and completed once

title: MVP: run the MadFit session on the owner's phone (SPEC §7)
Routine & block schema + validator; convert MadFit JSON (SPEC §6.1)
description: A block = named ordered list of intervals (exerciseId, displayName, gif, workSeconds, restSeconds, side, coachNote). A routine = metadata (title, equipment, est duration) + ordered list of block refs and/or inline intervals. Write data/SCHEMA.md and a tiny node validate script (no deps). Convert data/routines/madfit-30min-hiit.json to the schema as the reference example. This schema is the contract for everything else — engine, picker, and all future content.
acceptance_criteria: validate script passes on the converted MadFit routine; schema covers per-side exercises, combo intervals, and blocks reusable across routines

title: Port MadFit to final schema + GIF audit: 3 loose matches + missing #2 (SPEC §7)
description: Convert the mapped MadFit data (30 intervals, 27 GIFs, combo/loose matches) to the final schema. Review the 3 loose matches (commandos, pull-throughs, march-crunch) and interval 2 (bum kicks, no GIF) — pick the least-confusing visual for each, or a text-only card where the GIF would mislead.
acceptance_criteria: all 30 intervals show a sensible visual; no broken GIF refs

title: Deploy to GitHub Pages + real-phone test; done = one real workout completed
description: Enable Pages on main. Install on the actual phone, run a real session with background music. Fix whatever the real device breaks (it will). Two-line install note in README.
acceptance_criteria: user has completed one real MadFit workout using the app on their phone

title: Workout history + streaks: localStorage log, month calendar (SPEC §6.9)
description: Log completed sessions to localStorage (routine, date, completed/aborted at interval n). Month calendar with dots + current streak on home screen. No charts, no export — a personal streak nudge, nothing more.
acceptance_criteria: finish a session, see it on the calendar; streak counts consecutive days

title: PWA shell: offline via service worker, installable (SPEC §6.2)
description: index.html + manifest + service worker that precaches app files, routine JSONs, and the GIFs referenced by installed routines (not the whole catalog). Vanilla JS, no build step. Installable on Android/iOS from GitHub Pages; airplane-mode test must pass.
acceptance_criteria: app runs a full session in airplane mode after one online visit; Add-to-Home-Screen works

title: Interval engine: timestamp-anchored state machine (SPEC §6.3)
description: States: idle/work/rest/paused/done. Drift-free timing anchored to timestamps (not accumulated setInterval). Controls: pause/resume, skip fwd/back one interval, restart. Emits events (tick, intervalStart, intervalEnd, halfway, countdown321) that UI/audio subscribe to. Standalone module, testable in isolation.
acceptance_criteria: 30-interval run stays within 1s of wall clock; skip/pause/resume never desync the display

title: Workout screen UI, phone-first portrait dark (SPEC §6.4)
description: Big remaining-time display, current exercise GIF + name, next-up preview during rest, interval counter (n/30), overall progress bar, pause/skip buttons sized for sweaty thumbs. Portrait-first, dark background.
acceptance_criteria: full MadFit session runnable end-to-end on a phone without mis-taps

title: Audio cues via WebAudio that don't kill background music (SPEC §6.5)
description: WebAudio beeps: 3-2-1 countdown, distinct work-start and rest-start tones, optional halfway tick. Must NOT pause/duck the user's Spotify/YT Music — short WebAudio buffers, never an <audio> element with media-session. Verify mixing on Android Chrome and iOS Safari.
acceptance_criteria: cues audible over playing Spotify on a real phone; music never stops

title: Voice: pre-rendered FrankenTTS clips + SpeechSynthesis fallback (SPEC §6.6)
description: During rest, announce the next exercise name (and side); 'go'/'rest' at boundaries; toggleable; queued so speech never talks over the 3-2-1 beeps. Evaluate Jeff Emanuel's FrankenTTS (hot off the presses — research it first: quality, size, offline suitability, license) against plain browser SpeechSynthesis. SpeechSynthesis is the fallback: zero bytes but robotic and iOS needs a user-gesture unlock. If FrankenTTS is client-side and light enough, exercise names could even be pre-rendered to audio files at content-build time since the vocabulary is fixed per routine.
acceptance_criteria: eyes-free session possible; chosen TTS path documented in the bead with the rejected option's dealbreaker

title: Wake lock + ergonomics (SPEC §6.7)
description: Screen Wake Lock API with re-acquire on visibilitychange. Confirm timer correctness when the tab is backgrounded briefly (timestamp anchoring should cover it).
acceptance_criteria: screen stays on through a full 30-min session; backgrounding 10s does not desync

title: Home screen routine picker, zero-code routine add (SPEC §6.8)
description: Lists routines from data/routines/ with title, duration, equipment, exercise count. Tap to start. History/streaks will live here later — leave a slot, do not build it yet.
acceptance_criteria: adding a new routine JSON makes it appear with no code changes

title: Recover cowork data assets (catalog, 27 GIFs, transcript) or re-fetch via WorkoutX API
close_reason: Recovered from the cowork session's fittimer.zip (user download, 2026-08-10): full WorkoutX catalog + filter lists + openapi, all 27 GIFs, original routine JSON with target/bodyPart, YouTube transcript/oembed/thumbnail. Verified: 27 GIFs on disk, routine JSON parses with 30 intervals matching the spec table.
